full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case, in short, are that the present appellants as instituted Title Suit No.77 of 1979 in the 1St Court of Munsif, Goalandha, Rajbari (which was transferred later to the Court of the Assistant Judge, Pangsha, Rajbari and renumbered as Title Suit No.331 of 1983) for declaration of title in respect of 1.07 acres land and for confirmation of possession in the same in alternative to recovery of khas possession stating inter alia, that the land of RS Plot No.312 of RS Khatian No.255 corresponding to SA Khatian No.279 of Mouza-Maliyat originally belonged to Billada Sundari Saha and others. They are co-sharers in the suit land to the extent of 12 annas 5 gandas 1 kara 1 kranti and the rest 3 annas 14 gandas 2 kara 2 kranti belonged to Jagadish Chandra. Said Jagadish Chandra settled his share by an amalnama dated 8 Ashwin 1352BS to the plaintiff's predecessor and as such, they are in exclusive possession in 16 annas share in the suit land. It is further stated that SA record was wrongly prepared in the name of Jagadish Chandra along with the plaintiffs and the plaintiffs filed Miscellaneous Case No.XIII-68/77- 78 before the concerned Circle Officer (Revenue) who corrected the said Khatian. Defendant No.1 filed an appeal before the concerned Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) being Miscellaneous Appeal No.XX111/B-25/78- 79 which was allowed. Thereafter, the defendant threatened the plaintiff to dis-possess from the suit land and as such, the suit.
